days.note: Catch-up starts today. Offer the full amount every feed and let him leave what he does not want. Call the office and ask for a weight-only nurse check before Monday.
Both parents home. Nine feeds, no gap over 3 hours, day or night. Wake him if he sleeps through.
Last full day with both parents home. Weigh naked, same time, same scale. Write the number down for tomorrow.
Appointment 1:15 PM. Bring the question list. Dad back to work from home today.
Follow whatever volume the pediatrician set yesterday. If they raised it, this schedule needs updating.
Watch that the night feeds are still happening now that the work week has started.
If he is gaining 20-30 g a day, the 4:30 AM feed can start to slide later. If not, hold the schedule.
Growth spurt window opens - he may want more than target for a few days. Give it to him.
Weekend. Both parents home - use it to bank sleep, not to catch up on chores.
Weekly weight check at home. Compare against last Sunday, not against yesterday.
Three weeks old. If weight is on track, talk to the pediatrician about dropping one pump.
Cord stump should be long gone. If anything is still weeping or smells, call.
Check in on Mom, properly. Ask the question and wait for the real answer.
Steady state. This schedule only stays useful if it is still true - change it when it stops being.
If he is consistently over target and gaining well, this is the week to stretch the night gap.
Weekend. Review the week in Huckleberry - are the nine feeds actually happening?
Weekly naked weight. Expect roughly 150-210 g over the week.
Four weeks. Time to rebuild this schedule around who he is now rather than who he was at day 11.
